test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_churn_ts (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT 'churn_metric', map('pod', concat('old-', toString(number)), 'job', toString(number % 10)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(1000 + step * 15, 3), toFloat64(step)), range(40)) FROM numbers_mt(200000)

INSERT INTO promql_churn_ts (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT 'churn_metric', map('pod', concat('live-', toString(number)), 'job', toString(number % 10)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(1000000 + step * 15, 3), toFloat64(step)), range(240)) FROM numbers_mt(2000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange('promql_churn_ts', 'sum by (job) (rate(churn_metric[5m]))', 1001800, 1003600, 60) FORMAT Null
